THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, sleek slicked-back ash brown hair — her skin is her only outfit. Her bare skin below the jaw is painted in Cubist-fragmented pattern — sharp angular asymmetric flat planes seen from several angles at once, wide silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips like contour lines, dense angular fragment planes filling the space between every band; the paint is pigment sitting on living skin and covers her shoulders, arms, chest, midriff, hips and legs down to her ankles, her face left as real unpainted skin with the pattern fading out at the neck. Real photographic skin shows through the artwork across her whole body, with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs, a light scatter of faint freckles and small moles, the paint and ink sitting on living skin and her skin tone running naturally under it. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of glossy ivory leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.

Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline.

Background: a hexagonal room with floor-to-ceiling mirrors on all six walls and a white mirrored floor, soft white light from above, so that her figure repeats in a ring of identical reflections that recede in six directions like a kaleidoscope, the whole floor clearly visible and in focus, lit by bright soft white light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, the reflections being part of that same photograph, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
